//: Comprehensive TLS / mTLS / backend-TLS / health-check example. Every optional security feature is enabled and annotated. Strip the sections you don't need before deploying. Zero-value fields fall back to the defaults baked into pkg/config; documented inline below.

protocol.//lifeguard: Recommended on under any kind of load — Self-Awareness scaling absorbs head-of-line jitter that would otherwise mark healthy nodes suspect.

tls.//: Frontend HTTPS — terminates TLS for client→LB traffic. Requires both cert_file and key_file when enabled.
tls.//min_version: 1.2 is the floor; 1.3 if your clients support it. Older versions (1.0/1.1) are intentionally not exposed — known weak.
tls.//client_ca_file: Set this to a PEM bundle of trusted client CAs to enable mTLS. Clients without a cert signed by one of those CAs are rejected at handshake. Empty / unset = mTLS off.
tls.//auto_reload: Re-reads cert+key from disk on a timer so cert-manager rotations land without a restart. Atomic.Pointer swap — in-flight handshakes are not affected.

backend_tls.//: LB → backend HTTPS leg. Independent of frontend TLS: the LB can terminate at the edge and re-encrypt to backends, or do straight pass-through, or neither.
backend_tls.//skip_verify: DEV ONLY. With self-signed backend certs in production prefer setting ca_file to your private CA bundle. The validator logs a warning whenever this is true alongside enabled.
backend_tls.//ca_file: PEM bundle of additional trusted CAs for backend certs. Empty = use the system trust store.

health_check.//: HTTP-level checker that runs alongside SWIM gossip. Gossip-alive but health-failed backends are excluded from selection. Disabled by default; opt in per environment.
health_check.//thresholds: Consecutive successes/failures before flipping state. Higher numbers = slower transitions, fewer flapping events under transient noise.
health_check.//degraded_latency: 2xx responses slower than this count as Degraded. Degraded backends still receive traffic but are deprioritised by latency-aware selectors (P2C-EWMA).
